title: Venezuelan Water Chestnut Casserole
description: A hearty and earthy casserole featuring water chestnuts, flambe technique, and traditional Venezuelan flavors, all in a Buddhist-temple-friendly dish served in a cazuela.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
Heat the olive oil in a large skillet over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion and saute until translucent.
Add the minced garlic and saute for an additional minute.
Add the sliced mushrooms and saute until they release their moisture and start to brown.
Add the flambe rum and ignite, letting the flames cook for 30 seconds.
Add the sliced water chestnuts, tomato paste, and vegetable broth to the skillet, stirring to combine.
Transfer the mixture to a cazuela and top with crushed crackers and nutritional yeast.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown.
